line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.
line_check.coordinate_verification: Original bytes match at logical 288 (end of DWORD reader), 750 and 832 (distinct DEBUG terminators). Sequence alignment paired identical delimiters across omitted bodies.

decision: Original DWORD, string, integer readers retained. wow_profile_open_key restricts access to KEY_READ; DESKTOP uses current user and COMPAT requests machine native view. NT4 OpenCacheKeyEx instead depends on kernel process identity, impersonation and serialized path/cache ownership. Raw cache globals are state for that implementation. FastGetProfileKeysW needs pool reallocation and enumeration; FastGetProfileValue additionally dereferences server-owned string resources for integer IDs; FastWriteProfileStringW requests KEY_WRITE, which actual provider rejects. UT wrappers use FastOpen/FastCloseProfileUserMapping. No general kernel-profile service supplied by existing WOW binding. Do not duplicate its cache or invent a writable provider.

verification.scope: Fresh original/source hashes, filtered comparison, #line coordinate checks and source-level caller/provider audit; no new build or runtime test.
